Ben and Eva had great fun there. Both of them like soup and juice. They took many photos at the bus stop. Also, the skyline changes every few years.
Ben drinks juice after doing sports. Ben learned a lot about English. Ben usually has soup for breakfast. Cafés shade the old boulevard.
The weather was rainy that day. Ben's favorite animal is the cat. Ben thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. For example, her viola has a deeper, warmer sound than a violin.
Ben hopes to visit Xi'an one day. There are always many people at the bus stop. Last Tuesday, Ben and Eva went to the airport.
